identity.statusNote: Development pace has slowed significantly; latest stable version is 3.5.3, and the framework has been largely superseded by React/Vue in new projects.

capabilities.en: Declarative data-bindings linking DOM elements to a JavaScript view model, with automatic UI refresh on data changes
Dependency tracking between model properties and templating for dynamic UI generation

limitations.en: Small and lightweight (66kb minified) by design, offering a narrower scope than full frameworks like React or Vue
Development has slowed considerably; latest stable release is 3.5.3 with limited recent updates compared to modern frameworks

reason.en: Modern component-based UI library that has largely superseded Knockout for new projects
Modern reactive framework covering similar declarative-binding use cases
